- [Welcome from Mayor McMorran  
  \
  Welcome to Philomath! Nestled here in the foothills of Oregon's Coast Range, it is my genuine pleasure to welcome you to my hometown — and to invite you to explore all that our community has in store. This is the first of many welcomes you're sure to hear as you experience our city and meet the people who make this such a great place to live.  
  \
  Philomath literally means "lover of learning," and our town was founded on the ideals of education, hard work, volunteerism, community spirit, and connection to the land. Although we may be small, we have so much to offer: I encourage you to check out some of our fantastic restaurants, serving up food from local farms, fields, and wineries, or stop by a shop with local goods and services — and then get outdoors and experience the many vibrant parks and natural areas that surround our friendly neighborhoods and growing industries. If you really want to dive in, the Philomath Discovery Challenge is a great chance to do so.  
  \
